summary: Applied the revision-2 source-safety remediation to src/content/blog/beginner/short-heart-line-meaning.md. The 'Length in context' section previously asserted four combined readings that no approved repository source establishes as combinations: short line plus depth/faintness, short line plus a Saturn or Jupiter endpoint, short line plus Mount of Venus development, and short line plus a compact or expansive whole-hand pattern. Each is now reduced to separate observation guidance under an explicit caution that these variables sit alongside length rather than folding into a length-specific reading, and the two cases where approved sources are silent (Venus mount development, whole-hand proportion) now say so directly instead of asserting a meaning. Three equivalent cross-tradition/consensus overreaches were narrowed in the same focused pass: an Indian-tradition reading of heart line length specifically (approved evidence establishes Hridaya Rekha and bhava and structural similarity, not a length reading), 'Neither the Western nor the Indian tradition reads shortness this way', and 'No major tradition Palmistry Path draws from reads length as a relationship tally'. The accepted revision-1 structure, SEO intent, observation workflow, core bounded interpretation, reciprocal navigation, sources footer, and canonical-doc updates are otherwise preserved; the only doc change is one added CHANGELOG bullet recording the remediation. origin/main was merged into the branch first so the revision-2 dispatch commit is not reverted by the PR.

Re-scanned the article for most, generally, typically, always, never, consensus, modern, classical, Western, scientific, study, research, proves, predicts, cold, selfish, relationship, Venus, endpoint, deep, faint, compact; inspected every occurrence in context. Remaining hits are non-prevalence usages ('most worrying', 'most decisive'), anatomical description matching the lesson, explicitly negated myth statements, or phrasing carried verbatim in substance from src/content/lessons/lines/02-heart-line.mdx.

Re-checked every multi-feature sentence against src/content/lessons/lines/02-heart-line.mdx and src/content/blog/beginner/heart-line.md; no sentence now states a combined interpretive conclusion that approved repository evidence does not establish as a combination.

Reviewed the complete diff against origin/main for scope drift: bounded to the article body, one CHANGELOG bullet, the r2 result artifact, and the merge of main.
